title: Milk and butter for cream that must whip

evidence.basis: Authored refusal text from old whip-contrast v2; OD-2 approved for engineering only

text: This catalog doesn't accept milk and butter in place of cream that has to be whipped: a milk-and-butter mixture won't hold air or whip into peaks. This is about that replacement only.
scopeNote: This isn't a verdict on every alternative.
